description: Clean, natural pool development with realistic cyan-blue water, controlled reflections, and defined existing edges and surrounding materials.

exposure.instruction: Balance exposure across water, deck, sky, and surroundings for a luminous result without a tropical advertising look.

shadows.instruction: Open deep poolside and vegetation shadows while retaining natural outdoor depth.

highlights.instruction: Control water sparkle, pale paving, and other reflective highlights while preserving their real reflections and texture.

contrast.instruction: Create clean water, edge, and surrounding-material separation without artificial HDR or resort-style exaggeration.

whiteBalance.instruction: Keep surroundings neutral and natural while preserving realistic water color and atmosphere.

vibrance.instruction: Enrich muted color moderately without artificial tropical vegetation or water color.

saturation.instruction: Use controlled saturation in existing water and vegetation; preserve natural blue-cyan and green balance.

texture.instruction: Reveal real water, paving, and vegetation texture without inventing detail or distorting reflections.

clarity.instruction: Use restrained clarity so water remains photographic.

materialPriorities.instruction: Keep water clean with natural blue-cyan balance and preserve every existing reflection, ripple, boundary, and depth cue.
Keep surrounding vegetation realistic and distinct without tropical transformation.
